description.en: Automated backup with compression, checksum, and retention
description.de: Automatisiertes Backup mit Kompression, Checksumme und Retention

instructions: Erstelle ein Datenbank-Backup mit Kompression und Checksumme. Variablen: db_type (postgres/mysql/sqlite), db_connection, backup_dir, retention_count.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
DB_TYPE="{{ db_type }}"
DB_CONN="{{ db_connection }}"
BACKUP_DIR="{{ backup_dir }}"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
BACKUP_FILE="$BACKUP_DIR/${DB_TYPE}-backup-${TS}.sql"
echo "=== Creating $DB_TYPE backup ==="
if [ "$DB_TYPE" = "postgres" ]; then
  pg_dump "$DB_CONN" > "$BACKUP_FILE"
elif [ "$DB_TYPE" = "mysql" ]; then
  mysqldump $DB_CONN > "$BACKUP_FILE"
elif [ "$DB_TYPE" = "sqlite" ]; then
  python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.copy2('$DB_CONN', '$BACKUP_FILE')"
else
  echo "Unsupported db_type: $DB_TYPE" && exit 1
fi
echo "Backup created: $BACKUP_FILE ($(du -h "$BACKUP_FILE" | cut -f1))"

set -euo pipefail
BACKUP_DIR="{{ backup_dir }}"
LATEST=$(ls -t "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.sql 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then echo "No backup found!" && exit 1; fi
echo "=== Compressing $LATEST ==="
gzip -f "$LATEST"
COMPRESSED="${LATEST}.gz"
sha256sum "$COMPRESSED" > "${COMPRESSED}.sha256"
echo "Compressed: $COMPRESSED ($(du -h "$COMPRESSED" | cut -f1))"
echo "Checksum: $(cat "${COMPRESSED}.sha256")"

set -euo pipefail
BACKUP_DIR="{{ backup_dir }}"
LATEST_GZ=$(ls -t "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "$LATEST_GZ" ]; then echo "No compressed backup found!" && exit 1; fi
echo "=== Verifying checksum ==="
cd "$BACKUP_DIR"
sha256sum -c "$(basename "$LATEST_GZ").sha256"
echo "Checksum verification passed."

set -euo pipefail
BACKUP_DIR="{{ backup_dir }}"
RETENTION={{ retention_count }}
echo "=== Retention cleanup (keeping $RETENTION backups) ==="
COUNT=$(ls -1 "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
if [ "$COUNT" -gt "$RETENTION" ]; then
  REMOVE=$((COUNT - RETENTION))
  ls -t "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.sql.gz | tail -$REMOVE | while read f; do
    echo "Removing: $f"
    rm -f "$f" "${f}.sha256"
  done
  echo "Removed $REMOVE old backups."
else
  echo "$COUNT backups present, retention limit $RETENTION not exceeded."
fi

set -euo pipefail
BACKUP_DIR="{{ backup_dir }}"
echo "# Backup Report"
echo "Generated: $(date -Iseconds)"
echo "DB Type: {{ db_type }}"
echo "Backup Dir: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo ""
echo "## Current Backups"
ls -lh "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null || echo "No backups found."
echo ""
echo "## Disk Usage"
du -sh "$BACKUP_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
